description: The day's news digest as METADATA: top clustered headlines per sector with outlet, age in hours and how many outlets carried the story, which is the corroboration signal. No article text. Pair it with a price tool to explain a move.

include_urls.description: Include each item's link. Default false — the links are Google-News redirect tokens (65% of the untrimmed payload) that cannot be fetched as articles.

sector.description: Limit to one sector. Omit for all sectors.

top.description: Max headlines per sector and in topWeekly (default 3), and per watchlist company (default 1).

name: get_market_news
